image.alt: Millions of Dollars original Matagot box photographed by illustrator Cari in 2017

fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: The game illustrator Carole Chaland posted this photograph of the actual Matagot game box and cards on her own Tumblr https://blogcari.tumblr.com/post/160472213015 on 9 May 2017, describing it as her game from Matagot. Her portfolio https://cari.artstation.com/projects/mqOb6Z identifies her as illustrator of Millions of Dollars. The box and card art visually match the 2016 Matagot rulebook; this is not the later reissue. Cropped to the physical box. Reduced to 254 × 290 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently watched a heist movie receives the Leader card to begin the first round.
clarifications: At the end of each round, the Leader card passes to the next player clockwise.
